provenance.note: The 50 m station (24 of the 60 shots, D.10D.10) is shot on the full PP 1 face. The 10 m and 25 m stations use a PP 1 face reduced to 50 %, for which the book prints no dimensions and no record exists, so the shot count is that of the 50 m station.
